Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about ticketing, accessibility, transfers, and venue logistics.

Can I get a refund?

Yes, tickets can be fully refunded up to 30 days before the event starts.

Is there a student discount?

Yes, 50% discount is available with a valid verified student ID.

Will talks be recorded?

All main-stage talks are recorded and published in high definition within one week.

Is the venue accessible?

Fully step-free venue with accessible restrooms, elevators, and dedicated quiet rooms.

Can I transfer my ticket?

Yes, you can transfer your ticket to a colleague free of charge up to 48 hours prior to kickoff.
